# Five-column Fig. 4d-style GO-BP enrichment bar chart
#
# Uses all 50 rows in the previously generated compareCluster top-10 table:
# 10 terms each for Foregut, Midgut, Hindgut, Allantois and Yolk Sac Endoderm.
# Bars display -log10(BH-adjusted P values), with a shared 0-10 x scale.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(stringr)
  library(ragg)
})

input_csv <- file.path(
  "Tan_Fig4d_GO_compareCluster_output",
  "Fig4d_PanelC_compareCluster_GO_BP_top10.csv"
)
output_dir <- "Tan_Fig4d_GO_compareCluster_output"
output_stem <- file.path(output_dir, "Fig4d_all_groups_top10_GO_compareCluster_style")

lineage_order <- c(
  "Foregut", "Midgut", "Hindgut", "Allantois", "Yolk Sac Endoderm"
)
lineage_colors <- c(
  "Foregut" = "#F2A45C",
  "Midgut" = "#E7C86A",
  "Hindgut" = "#E56B4E",
  "Allantois" = "#82B94B",
  "Yolk Sac Endoderm" = "#D7E79A"
)
lineage_titles <- c(
  "Foregut" = "Foregut",
  "Midgut" = "Midgut",
  "Hindgut" = "Hindgut",
  "Allantois" = "Allantois",
  "Yolk Sac Endoderm" = "Yolk sac endoderm"
)

base_family <- "Helvetica Neue"
text_color <- "black"
axis_limit <- 10
row_spacing <- 0.18
base_bar_height <- 0.60
# Wide layout keeps all long GO terms on one line while leaving deliberate
# whitespace between the five columns.
figure_width_mm <- 400
figure_height_mm <- 75
figure_dpi <- 600

if (!file.exists(input_csv)) {
  stop("Input table not found: ", input_csv)
}
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

all_terms <- utils::read.csv(input_csv, check.names = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(Cluster %in% lineage_order) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = lineage_order),
    minus_log10_p_adjust = -log10(p.adjust)
  )

if (nrow(all_terms) != 50L) {
  stop("Expected 50 top-term rows across five lineages, found ", nrow(all_terms))
}
if (any(!is.finite(all_terms$minus_log10_p_adjust)) ||
    any(all_terms$minus_log10_p_adjust < 0)) {
  stop("p.adjust values must be finite values in (0, 1].")
}
if (max(all_terms$minus_log10_p_adjust) > axis_limit) {
  axis_limit <- ceiling(max(all_terms$minus_log10_p_adjust))
}

# Lay out the rows from top to bottom. Standard one- and two-line labels retain
# the base bar height. Only labels that occupy three lines receive extra height
# so that their own text remains legible; row gaps are never reduced by making
# ordinary bars thicker.
prepare_panel_data <- function(data, lineage) {
  panel <- data |>
    dplyr::filter(Cluster == lineage) |>
    dplyr::arrange(p.adjust, pvalue, dplyr::desc(Count), Description) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      term_label = Description,
      n_label_lines = 1L,
      bar_height = base_bar_height
    )

  if (nrow(panel) != 10L) {
    stop("Expected 10 terms for ", lineage, ", found ", nrow(panel))
  }

  y_min <- numeric(nrow(panel))
  y_max <- numeric(nrow(panel))
  cursor <- sum(panel$bar_height) + row_spacing * (nrow(panel) - 1L)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(panel))) {
    y_max[i] <- cursor
    y_min[i] <- cursor - panel$bar_height[i]
    cursor <- y_min[i] - row_spacing
  }

  panel |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      y_min = y_min,
      y_max = y_max,
      y_center = (y_min + y_max) / 2,
      panel_height = max(y_max)
    )
}

theme_fig4d_panel <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 6, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5, colour = text_color, margin = margin(b = 1.2, unit = "pt")),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1.2, b = 0, l = 1.2, unit = "pt")
    )
}

make_panel <- function(panel, lineage) {
  panel_color <- lineage_colors[[lineage]]
  panel_title <- lineage_titles[[lineage]]
  y_upper <- unique(panel$panel_height)[1] + 0.10

  p_header <- ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "rect", xmin = 0, xmax = axis_limit, ymin = 0, ymax = 1,
      fill = panel_color, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.70
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text", x = axis_limit / 2, y = 0.5, label = panel_title,
      family = base_family, size = 3.65, colour = text_color
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, axis_limit), ylim = c(0, 1), expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void(base_family = base_family) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1.2, b = 1.2, l = 1.2, unit = "pt"))

  p_bar <- ggplot(panel) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = 0, xmax = minus_log10_p_adjust,
        ymin = y_min, ymax = y_max
      ),
      fill = panel_color, colour = NA
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = 0.10, y = y_center, label = term_label),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, family = base_family,
      size = 2.8, lineheight = 0.85, colour = text_color
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      position = "top", breaks = c(0, 5, 10),
      limits = c(0, axis_limit), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, y_upper), breaks = NULL, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "on") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_fig4d_panel()

  p_header / p_bar + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(0.10, 1))
}

panel_data <- lapply(lineage_order, function(x) prepare_panel_data(all_terms, x))
names(panel_data) <- lineage_order
panels <- lapply(lineage_order, function(x) make_panel(panel_data[[x]], x))

figure <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  panels[[1]], patchwork::plot_spacer(),
  panels[[2]], patchwork::plot_spacer(),
  panels[[3]], patchwork::plot_spacer(),
  panels[[4]], patchwork::plot_spacer(),
  panels[[5]],
  nrow = 1,
  ncol = 9,
  widths = c(1, 0.12, 1, 0.12, 1, 0.12, 1, 0.12, 1)
)

plot_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(panel_data) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Cluster, p.adjust, pvalue, dplyr::desc(Count), Description)
utils::write.csv(
  plot_data,
  file.path(output_dir, "Fig4d_all_groups_top10_GO_plot_data.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

figure_width_in <- figure_width_mm / 25.4
figure_height_in <- figure_height_mm / 25.4

svglite::svglite(
  paste0(output_stem, ".svg"), width = figure_width_in, height = figure_height_in,
  bg = "white"
)
print(figure)
grDevices::dev.off()

grDevices::cairo_pdf(
  paste0(output_stem, ".pdf"), width = figure_width_in, height = figure_height_in,
  family = base_family, bg = "white"
)
print(figure)
grDevices::dev.off()

ragg::agg_png(
  paste0(output_stem, ".png"), width = figure_width_in, height = figure_height_in,
  units = "in", res = figure_dpi, background = "white"
)
print(figure)
grDevices::dev.off()

ragg::agg_tiff(
  paste0(output_stem, ".tiff"), width = figure_width_in, height = figure_height_in,
  units = "in", res = figure_dpi, background = "white", compression = "lzw"
)
print(figure)
grDevices::dev.off()

qa_notes <- c(
  "Figure contract",
  "Core conclusion: Panel-c representative gene sets show distinct top GO-BP enrichment patterns across five endoderm-associated lineages.",
  "Archetype: one-row, five-column quantitative enrichment grid.",
  "Input: 50 rows from the existing compareCluster top-10 result table, with 10 terms per lineage.",
  "Metric: -log10(BH-adjusted P value); all panels share a 0-10 x-axis range.",
  "Term ranking: p.adjust ascending, then pvalue ascending, Count descending, Description ascending.",
  "Rows displayed: all 50 top terms; no terms were omitted.",
  "Text layout: GO labels are black, left-aligned at each bar origin and kept on one line by using a wide five-column canvas with explicit column gaps.",
  "Bar layout: all bars retain 0.60 height; compact row gaps are 0.18.",
  "Typeface: Helvetica Neue, an installed visual substitute for Graphik Naturel.",
  "No biological replicate, effect-size, or uncertainty comparison is represented.",
  "Exports: editable SVG/PDF plus 600-dpi PNG/TIFF."
)
writeLines(qa_notes, paste0(output_stem, "_QA_notes.txt"))

message("Created five-column Fig. 4d-style GO-BP panel.")

# Vibe Coding 一下，顶刊同款富集图到手（直播预告）

> 署名作者：新叶
> 公众号：生信技能树
> 发布时间：2026年8月22日 22:52
> 原文：http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzAxMDkxODM1Ng==&mid=2247554014&idx=1&sn=ac07d055861daf7891f5032315e5e9e9&chksm=9b4b5365ac3cda7312b2c67653ffcd969ea5d9bff5c94ed8568b99f59b9c7fa58a778ee424cb#rd





前面我们开了一个AI绘图的交流群：[AI绘图交流群](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzAxMDkxODM1Ng==&mid=2247551833&idx=1&sn=1b63552dc15487d7a34f10dd09c50fda&scene=21#wechat_redirect)，感兴趣可进。今天来做一次AI绘图直播活动吧。



本次选图来自2026年5月发表在 nature cell biology杂志上的文献，标题《A three-dimensional spatial transcriptome atlas reconstructs early organogenesis in primate Carnegie stages 9 and 10 embryos》。复现的图是Fig4d。



## Fig4d的含义







图注：



Representative enriched GO terms of top DEGs associated with each endodermal cluster.



![教程配图](images/img_001.png)



它是按 foregut、midgut、hindgut、allantois、yolk sac endoderm 分组的 **top-DEG GO 富集结果图**。



图中每一栏是一个区域，表示五类内胚层相关区域，横向条形表示该 GO 生物过程在该区域 top DEGs 中的富集强度。整体结论是：肠管已经沿前后轴分出不同的器官形成潜能，同时卵黄囊保留独立的胚外营养代谢功能。



**Foregut（前肠）**：富集“胚胎上皮管形成”“咽系统发育”“胸腺、肝脏、肝胆系统发育”等。说明前肠已具有形成咽部、胸腺、肝胆等前部内胚层器官的早期程序，而非单纯的未分化内胚层。



**Midgut（中肠）**：富集“纤毛组织”“纤毛内运输”“BMP 响应”“消化道发育”“极化上皮形态发生”等。重点是上皮组织化与成熟：细胞开始建立极性、纤毛相关结构和消化道上皮特征。



**Hindgut（后肠）**：富集“经典 WNT 信号”“间充质形态发生”“泌尿生殖系统发育”“肾系统发育”等。表示后肠处于强烈的后端化/尾侧模式化环境。这里的“前列腺、肾”等词不是说这些成熟器官已经形成，而是相关基因集在该早期后端组织中被启动。



**Allantois（尿囊）**：富集“性分化”“性腺发育”“趋化性正调控”“内皮细胞趋化”等。它提示尿囊不仅是后端胚外结构，也可能构成一个与细胞迁移、性腺相关发育环境相连的后端微环境；这与后续 PGC 位于 hindgut–allantois 区域的分析相呼应。



**Yolk sac endoderm（卵黄囊内胚层）**：富集“脂质/固醇/脂蛋白运输”“脂肪酸与磷脂代谢”“血红素生物合成”等。这是最清晰的胚外支持程序：承担营养物质处理、脂质运输和早期造血相关代谢支持，而不是参与肠管器官形成。



#### 数据来源



作者这个图的数据放在了 附件 source_data_fig4.xlsx，



https://media.springernature.com/original/springer-static/esm/art%3A10.1038%2Fs41556-026-01956-2/MediaObjects/41556_2026_1956_MOESM9_ESM.xlsx



5个区域的高表达基因给我们了，我们只要做一下功能富集分析就可以。



![教程配图](images/img_002.png)



## Vibe Coding复现



### Step1：做一下功能富集分析



这里我直接告诉他用一个函数去做多组别的GO数据库的功能富集分析，提示词如下：



读取Fig4d的数据，根据Panel c这个表格里面这5类基因做GO富集，使用 clusterProfiler的compareCluster，可以一次做多个组别的功能富集分析。输出表格和代码。



![教程配图](images/img_003.png)



做好了，我简单检查了一下结果，没有什么问题。



每组 top 10 按 **BH 校正后的 P 值（`p.adjust`）从小到大**筛选，即统计显著性最强的 10 条 GO-BP 通路。



### Step2：先绘制其中一组的条形图



提示词如下，我这里多给了一点细节：



根据Fig4d图，根据你挑选的top10通路先以Foregut组别为例绘制同款条形图。注意，这个条形图顶部有标题，横轴位于上方，GO term名称与条形图形左对齐。



这是第一版：



![教程配图](images/img_004.png)



我们调整一下细节：我总感觉他的颜色识别失真了，没有原文的好看。



标题和坐标轴刻度标签可以大一点，没有坐标轴刻度线和轴线，GO term的字体可以大一点，字体用的黑色，原图同款字体。条形之间的间隔可以小一点。



![教程配图](images/img_005.png)



这个版本还算可以的！



### Step3：5组图拼在一起



上面鞭打AI之后，得到了一个比较满意的图，现在就可以让它把5组都绘制在一起啦：



你现在把5组富集结果都按照这个标准绘制，拼图在一起，一行五列，跟Fig4d保持一致。



后面我还做了一些细节调整，最终效果如下：



![教程配图](images/img_006.png)
